title: Kolhapur Protest Erupts Over Maharashtra Ordinance On Gokul Milk Cooperative Board

ai.summary: Dairy farmers and opposition leaders marched in Kolhapur against Maharashtra's ordinance granting voting rights to four nominated directors in Gokul milk cooperative, which could increase the ruling Mahayuti's board strength from 12 to 16 members.

facts.claim: The Maharashtra government's move to give voting rights to four nominated directors in the Gokul milk cooperative sparked large protests in Kolhapur on Monday
facts.quote: - Dairy farmers and opposition leaders marched in Kolhapur on Monday against the Maharashtra government's ordinance on Gokul

facts.claim: The ordinance gives voting rights to four nominated directors and could raise the Mahayuti's strength on the 25-member board from 12 to 16
facts.quote: - The ordinance gives voting rights to four nominated directors and could raise the Mahayuti's strength on the 25-member board from 12 to 16

facts.claim: The protest was led by the Rajarshi Shahu Shetkari Samvichari Aghadi, headed by Congress MLC Satej Patil
facts.quote: - The protest was led by the Rajarshi Shahu Shetkari Samvichari Aghadi, headed by Congress MLC Satej Patil

facts.claim: Dairy farmers and opposition parties marched to the district collectorate with cattle to oppose the ordinance
facts.quote: Dairy farmers and opposition parties marched to the district collectorate with cattle to oppose the ordinance

facts.claim: The ordinance changes the balance of power in a cooperative where the opposition-backed panel had won a narrow edge in the recent election
facts.quote: The ordinance changes the balance of power in a cooperative where the opposition-backed panel had won a narrow edge in the recent election

facts.claim: Gokul is a cooperative institution with an annual turnover of more than Rs 4,000 crore
facts.quote: Gokul is a cooperative institution with an annual turnover of more than Rs 4,000 crore

facts.claim: The Rajarshi Shahu Shetkari Samvichari Aghadi, led by Congress MLC Satej Patil, won 13 of the 25 seats in the October 19 elections to the Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union
facts.quote: The Rajarshi Shahu Shetkari Samvichari Aghadi, led by Congress MLC Satej Patil, won 13 of the 25 seats in the October 19 elections to the Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union

facts.claim: The new nomination rule now threatens to overturn that advantage by adding voting strength to the ruling side
facts.quote: The new nomination rule now threatens to overturn that advantage by adding voting strength to the ruling side

ai.background_note: Maharashtra government's ordinance to give voting rights to four nominated directors in Gokul milk cooperative, which could increase ruling Mahayuti's board strength from 12 to 16 members, has sparked protests led by opposition alliance.
